NAT10-mediated regulatory mechanisms in various human cancers

Schematic overview of NAT10-mediated regulatory mechanisms in various human cancers. NAT10 exerts oncogenic or tumor-promoting effects through multiple pathways, including ac4C modification of RNAs (majority), direct acetylation of protein substrates, and protein–protein interactions. These mechanisms collectively influence gene expression, signaling pathways, and cellular processes that contribute to cancer progression
